blockers.title: The contract reverses D-002's explicit whole-row deferral and falsely recasts slice 1 as authoritative
blockers.subjectClaim: The subject says D-002's first slice is an authoritative offline analysis profile, says DR-106 is a hard blocker for that profile, and expressly refuses to treat D-002 as a recorded deferral of DR-106.
blockers.refutation: The pinned governing decision says the opposite three times. D-002 lines 414-418 define slice-1 state as 'local, non-authoritative only', put authoritative sealed closure, replay, and evidence custody OUT of slice 1, and defer DR-106, DR-109, and DR-113 WHOLLY. Lines 437-443 list DR-106 again among explicit deferrals, 'each deferred WHOLLY'. Lines 453-463 exclude DR-106 from the condition-2 affected-row set and say its design enters a later slice. Because D-112 to D-114 is append-only, these D-002 bytes are identical at the subject pin and review HEAD.
blockers.sourceConflict: File 04 lines 40-46—the very rule the subject carries—permits a declared non-authoritative slice to defer storage mechanics by a recorded scope disposition, never silently. D-002 supplies exactly that recorded disposition. The subject first carries this rule, then denies that its matching disposition applies.
blockers.impact: This is not a wording defect. It silently overturns an adopted preference-laden slice decision, changes DR-106 from an explicitly later-slice row into a first-slice hard blocker, and misstates the authority on which the candidate says it relies. Although the candidate binds NOTHING and has not moved DR-106, it cannot be accepted as a faithful extraction while its central applicability claim is the inverse of the governing source.
blockers.minimumRepair: Record the exact D-002 standing: slice 1 is non-authoritative; authoritative closure is out; DR-106, DR-109, and DR-113 are explicitly—not silently—deferred wholly and enter a later slice. Remove the first-slice hard-blocker and authoritative-profile claims. Retain this contract only as a candidate for the later slice that includes authoritative closure unless a separately authorized successor overturns D-002.

shouldFix.title: The row-verification instruction compares one cell to the entire serialized row
shouldFix.subjectClaim: The reviewer is instructed: 'if the fifth cell differs from rowVerbatim, that is a finding against this artifact'.
shouldFix.refutation: rowVerbatim contains the complete seven-cell Markdown row, while the fifth cell contains only 'Applied DR-002–008; clean-machine no-network tests; durable retention and typed storage-failure results'. Those values necessarily differ even when the row is exact. The actual complete live DR-106 row occurs once at file-08 line 288 and exact-equals rowVerbatim, so the source carry is correct but the prescribed test is structurally impossible.
shouldFix.impact: A literal independent reviewer would manufacture a mismatch against every valid row. The exact row itself remains correct, so this is not a blocker; it is a reproducibility defect in the review protocol embedded in the candidate.
shouldFix.minimumRepair: Instruct comparison of the complete live row to rowVerbatim. If a fifth-cell-only check is desired, add a separately named fifth-cell value and compare like with like.
